name: Infiltrator — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Infiltrator from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Infiltrator (Story)" but are not part of the Infiltrator entry, which is unchanged.

Quest (Roll a 1d4)
You must use the rigorous training you received from skilled inquisitors to join and thwart your foes.
A conservatory gave you the identity of a distant relative of a rival information broker so you could erase the broker’s records and eliminate important witnesses of their psychic spying.
Although you were sent as a spy by a ninja clan, you came to think of your targets as your new kin. When you were caught, you managed to convince your former targets to keep you on as a double agent, and when you were called back to report, you went as a spy for your new home.
The church assigned you to infiltrate the ranks of a secret cult.
